stories.title: Keir Starmer’s policy on the Iran war is a recipe for catastrophe
stories.summary: The British government's policy on the Iran war draws criticism for allegedly repeating mistakes made during the US-UK invasion of Iraq.

stories.title: QatarEnergy declares force majeure on some LNG contracts amid Iran war
stories.summary: QatarEnergy has declared force majeure on some liquefied natural gas contracts due to production disruptions caused by the ongoing US-Israeli war on Iran affecting the Gulf region.

stories.title: Is the US talking to Iran’s Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, and who is he?
stories.summary: Iranian leaders, including Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, have denied that any talks with the United States are currently taking place.

stories.title: Philippines declares energy emergency over Iran conflict
stories.summary: Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr declared an energy emergency, citing imminent danger to the country's energy supplies due to the Iran conflict.

stories.title: Why has India arrested US, Ukrainian nationals under anti-terror laws?
stories.summary: India arrested six Ukrainian nationals and one American under anti-terror laws after they allegedly crossed from India into Myanmar to train armed groups in drone warfare.

stories.title: Israel says it will take control of large buffer zone in southern Lebanon
stories.summary: Israel announced it will take control of a large buffer zone in southern Lebanon, with officials stating displaced Lebanese residents cannot return until northern Israel is deemed safe.

stories.title: Search for four missing soldiers after Colombia plane crash kills 66
stories.summary: A Colombian military Hercules transport plane crashed shortly after take-off near the southern border with Peru, killing 66 people, with search operations ongoing for four missing soldiers.

stories.title: At least five killed in massive wave of Russian strikes across Ukraine, officials say
stories.summary: Russian strikes hit eleven regions across Ukraine in one of the worst attack waves in ten days, killing at least five people according to Ukrainian officials.

stories.title: Elon Musk's Starlink blocked from operating in Namibia
stories.summary: Namibia's telecommunications regulator blocked Elon Musk's Starlink from operating in the country, citing that Starlink's subsidiary does not meet local ownership requirements.

stories.title: Inside the alleged Russian operation to trigger anti-government protests in Angola
stories.summary: A group of Russians and Angolans are standing trial in Angola on accusations of attempting to foment anti-government protests, charges which the defendants deny.

stories.title: UK universities flock to India - but will they succeed?
stories.summary: Nine UK universities are establishing campuses in India, though initial student enrollment is expected to be modest.

stories.title: A committed pharmacist and a homesick blogger – the Iranian civilians killed in the war
stories.summary: Civilian casualties continue to rise in Iran as the US-Israeli military campaign continues, with victims including a pharmacist and a blogger among those killed.

stories.title: Ex-teacher accused of Scotland school abuse found guilty of sex attack in South Africa
stories.summary: A court in Cape Town, South Africa found former Scottish teacher Iain Wares guilty of indecently assaulting a former student who accused him of sexual abuse dating back to the 1980s.

stories.title: US' and Iran's options for ending war narrow the longer it goes on
stories.summary: The ongoing war between the US and Iran shows diminishing options for resolution, with Iran refusing to back down and US air power alone proving insufficient to achieve its objectives.

stories.title: Israeli settlers target Palestinian villages in occupied West Bank, attacking people and properties
stories.summary: Israeli settlers attacked Palestinian villages and properties in the occupied West Bank following the death of 18-year-old settler Yehuda Sherman, who was reportedly struck by a Palestinian-driven vehicle while on his quad bike.

stories.title: National blackout hits Cuba for second time in a week
stories.summary: Cuba experienced a second nationwide power grid failure within a week, highlighting the country's ongoing energy crisis amid a US-imposed fuel blockade.

stories.title: Israel to expand ground and air attacks against Hezbollah in Lebanon
stories.summary: Israel has announced plans to expand its ground and air military operations against Hezbollah in Lebanon, raising concerns about a potential large-scale ground invasion.

stories.title: Car stolen with two-month-old baby inside
stories.summary: A car was stolen with a two-month-old baby inside, but police successfully rescued the infant unharmed and reunited him with his mother shortly afterward.

stories.title: Venezuelan leader replaces senior military commanders
stories.summary: Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro replaced senior military commanders following the appointment of a new defence minister by Vice President Delcy Rodríguez, a move that human rights organizations criticized as perpetuating impunity.
